headline: Six Fronts Intensify as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Three hours on, the war’s most contested sectors have sharpened. Callahans Passage now records 12,396 Colonial and 14,627 Warden dead, 806 fresh enlistments and 68 ownership changes, four of them in the last two hours. Weathered Expanse adds 10,911 Colonial and 16,802 Warden casualties, 577 recruits and 27 flips, three recorded since the last edition. Fishermans Row surges to 597 Colonial and 655 Warden losses, 281 new troops and 58 exchanges, six in the past two hours. Stlican Shelf tallies 3,566 Colonial and 3,385 Warden dead, 426 enlistees and 60 base changes, one fresh. Mooring County reports 3,811 Colonial and 3,991 Warden casualties, 552 recruits and 12 flips, five recent. Nevish Line climbs to 6,618 Colonial and 6,406 Warden dead, 744 enlistments and 17 ownership shifts, nine in the last two hours. The remaining regions show no base‑ownership movement and only modest casualty drift.
